# Yeonsoo Kim (김연수) — github.com/yeonsooooooo

> I build the operating system for unmanned hotels — from PCB firmware to LLMs.

Based in Seoul, KR. 2,834 commits in the last year across 90 repositories (68 private; the public contribution graph shows only 18).

## Stack, top to bottom
- intelligence: LLM · RAG · vision · speech-to-text · forecasting (16 repos)
- surface: Next.js dashboards · React Native · SwiftUI · Flutter (42 repos)
- core: NestJS · MySQL · schedulers · payments · PMS (10 repos)
- edge: touch kiosks (Electron) · Android agents · RPA (14 repos)
- silicon: 30-ch PCB firmware · RTSP / WebRTC camera relay (5 repos)
